Third-party notices for js/vendor/
==================================

UniversalCodeMaker.com ships these open-source libraries unmodified (minified builds).
All are used under the MIT License; the full licence text is at the end of this file.
The scanner library has its own notices in zxing-wasm-3.1.4/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt,
and the web fonts in assets/fonts/ (SIL Open Font License 1.1).

  File                   Library                                  Version
  ---------------------  ---------------------------------------  --------
  bwip-js-min.js         bwip-js (barcode drawing)                4.11.4
                         includes Barcode Writer in Pure PostScript (BWIPP) 2026-05-28
  qr-code-styling.js     qr-code-styling (styled QR codes)        1.9.2
                         includes qrcode-generator
  jspdf.umd.min.js       jsPDF (PDF label sheets)                 4.2.1
  jszip.min.js           JSZip (batch ZIP downloads)              3.10.1
                         includes pako

Copyright notices
-----------------

bwip-js
  Copyright (c) 2011-2026 Mark Warren
  https://github.com/metafloor/bwip-js

Barcode Writer in Pure PostScript (BWIPP), included in bwip-js
  Copyright (c) 2004-2024 Terry Burton
  https://github.com/bwipp/postscriptbarcode

qr-code-styling
  Copyright (c) 2019 Denys Kozak
  https://github.com/kozakdenys/qr-code-styling

qrcode-generator, included in qr-code-styling
  Copyright (c) 2009 Kazuhiko Arase
  https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator

jsPDF (includes fflate and fast-png, both MIT)
  Copyright (c) 2010-2025 James Hall, https://github.com/MrRio/jsPDF
  2015-2025 yWorks GmbH and the other contributors listed in the header of
  jspdf.umd.min.js

JSZip (dual licensed MIT or GPLv3; used here under the MIT License)
  Copyright (c) 2009-2016 Stuart Knightley, David Duponchel, Franz Buchinger,
  Antonio Afonso
  https://github.com/Stuk/jszip

pako, included in JSZip
  Copyright (C) 2014-2017 by Vitaly Puzrin and Andrei Tuputcyn
  https://github.com/nodeca/pako
